analysis_status: The first frozen release-generation run stopped when a TVAE draw produced a single-class synthetic table. No target record or target outcome had been opened. This amendment retains every frozen release seed and treats an untrainable release as failing every registered bounded-loss requirement.
unit_loss_interpretation: Classification error, Brier loss, and normalized 5-to-1 decision cost are each assigned their registered upper bound one. The failed seed remains in both the named and direct mechanism denominators.
